title: How to File Income Tax Return Online: Step-by-Step E-Filing Guide
summary: A step-by-step walkthrough for filing ITR online, checking refund status, reconciling AIS/Form 26AS, and choosing Old vs New Tax Regime.
body:
E-filing your Income Tax Return (ITR) online on incometax.gov.in requires cross-verifying pre-filled financial data to avoid processing delays or scrutiny notices.

Step-by-Step Filing Workflow:
1. Portal Login & AIS Reconciliation: Verify interest income, stock dividends, and capital gains in your Annual Information Statement (AIS) against Form 26AS.
2. Selecting the Correct Form: Use ITR-1 for salaried income up to ₹50 Lakhs, ITR-2 for capital gains, and ITR-3/4 for business or FnO trading income.
3. Tax Regime Comparison: Evaluate tax liability under the Old vs New Tax Regime before submitting.
4. E-Verification & Refund Tracking: E-verify via Aadhaar OTP within 30 days to enable CPC refund processing.

Have multiple Form 16s or capital gains? Schedule a direct review at our [Baidyabati Municipal Chamber Desk](/locations/baidyabati-sheoraphuli) or [Book an Appointment](/schedule).
